rules.text: If each category's adjacent printed percentage is the dashboard's current labeled rating-share value, and the public follow-up rule requires selecting the category with the highest such labeled value, then the eligible form option corresponding to the uniquely largest printed percentage is the required category selection.
rules.component: chart label/category binding and task-to-action relation
rules.conditions: The printed percentages are authoritative labeled rating-share values, each is attached to the category beneath its mark, and the task's specified decision rule governs this form.

rules.text: If the vertical positions of the plotted dots on the axis labeled "Value" encode the same decision metric that the task calls current labeled rating share, then the highest-positioned dot supplies a competing ranking; a disagreement between that ranking and the adjacent printed percentages leaves the proposed selection dependent on resolving which encoding is authoritative.
